# YCB Object and Model Set notice

The YCB object-model data is provided by the Yale-CMU-Berkeley Object and
Model Set contributors. The official YCB dataset page states that the dataset
is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license
(CC BY 4.0); the license text is at
<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>.

Attribution: Berk C. Calli, Arjun Singh, Aaron Walsman, Siddhartha Srinivasa,
Pieter Abbeel, and Aaron M. Dollar, “The YCB Object and Model Set: Towards
Common Benchmarks for Manipulation Research,” ICAR 2015.

Source and object-level downloads: <https://ycb-benchmarks.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html>.
The YCB Google-scanner 16k archives in this directory are redistributed under
the dataset's CC BY 4.0 terms. Any changes made in derived USD scenes are
described in the scene and asset manifests. The YCB license applies to the
YCB data; it does not automatically apply to the surrounding project code.
